report: You are 2-7 and lost 83.9 to 128.8 last week. Nobody on your roster has a new injury designation, so there are no forced replacements. The lineup is already the best it can be this week, so make no start/sit changes. Rachaad White plays Thursday at NYG, who rank 29th against RBs. The weak spots are RB2 (White 9.7), the QB (Stafford 12.3 over his last 3) and LaPorta (5.5 over his last 3). Send the Stroud offer to zaneruth first, since Stroud averages 20.5 and 24.95 over his last 3. Then send Tuten from Ashtonmoore12 and Jeanty from daddyisback8.

team_breakdown.note: Stafford averages 15.87 with a 12.33 last-3 and a floor of 9.12. He is a bottom-half starter, and Stroud at 20.5 is a clear upgrade.
Javonte Williams (17.73) is a real RB1. White (9.74) and Stevenson (12.63) are weak and cap the lineup.
Higgins (19.98, 28.17 over his last 3) and McMillan (15.56) are solid starters. Jameson Williams (13.21) is a decent flex.
LaPorta averages 11.64 but has scored 5.5 over his last 3. Mayer (9.09) is only a backup.
Stevenson (12.63) and J. Williams (13.21) hold the flex spots. Flournoy (9.31) is the next man up.
McConkey, Cooper and Strong are all Out. Black (4.71) and McGowan (3.63) rarely score, so the bench holds little usable depth.

plan: Send the Stroud (zaneruth) offer to upgrade QB by about +4.6 points per week.
Get a real RB2 through Tuten (Ashtonmoore12) or Jeanty (daddyisback8) to replace White's 9.74.
Cut Out players for usable bench pieces (Boutte, Ekeler, Hutchinson).

waivers.why: Boutte averages 7.86 (11.87 last 3) against McGowan's 3.63 on 31% of snaps.
S. Williams averages 8.08 against Shaheed's 6.03 on 32% of snaps.

drops.why: Strong is Out; Ekeler has 6.73 last-3 with 8.3 carries and is WAS's RB behind White.
Knight is a third-string RB with no stats; Hutchinson averages 8.29 on 81% of snaps.

trades.why: Stroud is the target: 20.51 average, 24.95 over his last 3, and a 16.48 floor. He sits on zaneruth's bench behind Jayden Daniels (19.42), and I would start him over Stafford's 15.87. Bowers is Out, so Mayer (9.09) fills a TE hole against Andrews at 6.52, and Flournoy gives WR depth after Tate went Out. This is MORE POINTS and MORE RELIABLE.
trades.their_need: TE since Bowers is Out; WR depth
trades.opener: Mayer plus Flournoy for Stroud, you keep Daniels.
trades.fallback: Add Tank Dell for Mayer and Flournoy; walk away if he wants Stafford too.
trades.text: Sent you an offer for your backup QB, take a look.

If the Stroud trade lands I don't need Stafford; otherwise I'd add Drew Lock (15.59) off waivers. Their QB Geno Smith is Out and Nix is on bye, so Stafford at 15.87 fills a hole. This is MORE POINTS.

trades.fallback: Add McGowan on my side; walk away if he asks for more than that.

This is MORE RELIABLE.
